title.purpose: Card/modal headings, week label, day numbers.

body.purpose: Recipe names, form labels, general UI copy.

label.purpose: Dates, quantities, prep time, counts — anything numeric.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Already in use for the ingredient-autocomplete dropdown. Standard shadow for content that floats over the page without commanding full attention.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Proposed, not yet implemented. For modal panels — should replace the current shadow-less modal panel per the committed elevation direction.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action per screen (e.g. 'Maak weekplan', 'Recept opslaan').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #232823; color: #EEEBE2; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5C7A5E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav / Icon Button
components.description: Week navigation arrows, header buttons, the lock toggle in its unlocked state.
components.css: .ds-btn-nav { background: #F7F5EE; color: #232823; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #C9C2AE; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-nav:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5C7A5E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Tag filter pills in the Recepten list (Alle / Vegetarisch / Vlees / Vis).
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; border: 1.5px solid #C9C2AE; background: #fff; color: #5C5F52; } .ds-chip--active { border-color: #5C7A5E; background: rgba(92,122,94,0.13); color: #5C7A5E; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: The repeating skeleton used by the day grid, Recepten list, and Ingrediënten list: icon/indicator left, content middle, action right, flat with a bottom border.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #C9C2AE; } .ds-row__dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5C7A5E; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-row__content { flex: 1; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #232823; } .ds-row__meta { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #8A8570; }

narrative.overview: Kookplan reads like a handwritten household inventory book, not a food-delivery app: warm paper tones, a serif display face for headings, and JetBrains Mono standing in for a grocer's tally marks wherever a number appears. The mood is warm and utilitarian: function comes first, but the warm paper background and Fraunces headings keep it from reading as a spreadsheet. The system is evolving toward slightly more depth than exists today — modals and floating panels should feel lifted off the page, not just outlined.
keyCharacteristics: Ledger-inspired: mono type for anything numeric, serif for anything read as a heading
One dominant accent (sage), used sparingly and consistently for the same meaning
Flat list rows as the default; elevation reserved for floating content — the one place the system is intentionally moving beyond today's implementation
Store identity colors double as recipe-tag colors in one case (blue = both 'vis' and Albert Heijn) — deliberate reuse, not a collision

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage is the only color used to mean "good / active / go." Don't introduce a second general-purpose accent color.

rules.name: The Dual-Category Rule
rules.body: AH-blue means either the "vis" recipe tag or the Albert Heijn store badge, never both in the same context. Don't let a third meaning creep onto this color.

rules.name: The Ledger Number Rule
rules.body: Any number a user would write down while shopping or cooking renders in JetBrains Mono, smaller and muted compared to surrounding text.

rules.name: The Page vs. Float Rule
rules.body: Content that's part of the normal page flow stays flat (border and tint only). Content that overlays other content gets a shadow. Never add a shadow to something that isn't actually floating above something else.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for any number treated as data — never for headings or prose.
Do keep sage as the only positive/active accent color.
Do give floating/overlaid surfaces a real shadow now that the direction has shifted.
Do keep list rows flat with a bottom border.
Do lock editable row fields behind a pencil tap by default.
donts: Don't add a shadow to something that isn't actually floating above other content.
Don't introduce a second general-purpose accent color alongside sage.
Don't repurpose rust for anything other than "vlees" or a destructive/negative action.
Don't use AH-blue for a third meaning beyond "vis" and "Albert Heijn."
